subject: GCP & Azure invoices: root cause for metering delta (timestamp shift) and credit plan
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@skylarkanalytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@skylark-ops.com
Date: Sun, 14 Jul 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected delta on June GCP invoice vs seller report

Hi Jonas —

We ran a reconciliation between the invoice Redwood issued for June (GCP marketplace) and the usage payload we receive from the seller reports. There is a persistent ~2.7% delta on billed 1h requests that maps to timestamps falling between 23:00-01:00 UTC. In our case those requests are attributed to the UK entity for VAT purposes, but the seller report is bucketing them into the prior day (seller local tz). As a result the VAT pass-through and entity mapping differ and the net VAT owed looks off.

Attached: skylark_june_usage_detail_UTC_shift.csv — it has sample rows and our aggregation. Can Greenwood (Redwood) confirm whether your metering pipeline normalizes to UTC or to seller local timezone for marketplace pushes? We need to propose a fix to our tax team ASAP — they asked for a breakdown and a timeline for credits if applicable.

Requested next steps:
- Short explanation of root cause (how timestamps are normalized in your ingestion)
- Proposed ledger correction or credit schedule for the 2.7% delta (if verified)
- Estimated timeline for evidence + official credit memo

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Finance Ops — Skylark Analytics
elena@skylarkanalytics.com
+44 20 7946 08xx

---
Note: billing@skylark-ops.com included for their records.

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@skylarkanalytics.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Jul 2029 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected delta on June GCP invoice vs seller report

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the data, this is the kind of detailed example we needed. Short answer up front: the marketplace metering ingestion normalizes to UTC at the moment incoming meter events are reconciled; however there is an upstream seller feed that publishes events in seller-local-time and a nightly job (meter-merge) that applies a cutoff at 00:00 seller-local. Under a daylight-savings overlap/clock-shift edge-case we have seen an off-by-one-day bucket for a small subset of late-night requests.

I raised INF-3129 with Product/Runtime to track the root cause and the immediate mitigation (ensure meter-merge uses UTC anchor + idempotent de-dup). See JIRA link in metadata.

Immediate proposed customer path:
- We will validate your CSV against our raw meter events and produce a per-line reconciliation by EOD Monday (your TZ).
- If the 2.7% delta is confirmed, Redwood will issue a credit memo covering billed token/usage discrepancy and a separate VAT recalculation for your EU entity.
- Finance will provide a proposed journal entry file and a signed credit memo within 7 business days after we confirm (we'll include audit notes).

I've looped in Vanessa (Marketplace Billing) and Marissa (Revenue Ops) to scope the finance steps and expedite the credit.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0217

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected delta on June GCP invoice vs seller report — proposed accounting entries

Folks —

I pulled a quick draft of the accounting entries assuming the delta is confirmed (attached proposed_journal_entries_20290715.xlsx). Key asks for Finance:
- Confirm whether we book the adjustment as an "invoice credit" (reduce AR) vs "post-billing correction" (contra-revenue). Tax: if VAT was remitted already, we need to coordinate reclaims with the seller entity; Elena noted the VAT mapping flips because of bucket alignment.
- Can Legal sign off on a one-time credit memo template? I've attached an audit evidence request template we plan to send Skylark to collect signatures and tax IDs.

Operational plan (if delta validated):
1) Validate per-line usage match (Jonas/Product) — target: Tue EOD (Skylark TZ).
2) Finance review & finalize journal entries — target: Wed EOD.
3) Issue credit memo + revised invoice — target: within 7 business days of validation.
4) Postmortem + patch for meter-merge to use UTC anchor — target: patch in hotfix release next week.

CC: Karthik, can you be prepared to run the per-line reconciliation query? Use meter-log-snapshots from 2029-06-30 and join on event_id. If we confirm, please open an ops-run ticket with exact SQL so we can audit.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed_journal_entries_20290715.xlsx, audit_evidence_request_template.pdf

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@skylarkanalytics.com>, billing@skylark-ops.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected delta on June GCP invoice vs seller report — next steps and timeline

Elena —

We validated your sample lines against our raw meter events and confirmed the off-by-one-day bucket for the set you provided. Summary: the seller-local cutoff in the nightly meter-merge moved ~1,100 events (0.9% by volume, 2.8% by billed value) across the day boundary for June 30 -> July 1; when those events are assigned to the UK seller entity they changed VAT treatment.

What we'll do next:
- Redwood will issue a credit memo for the net billed difference: credit of EUR 12,740.21 (line-level detail attached in the follow-up).
- We will issue a revised invoice that reflects the VAT reallocation for your EU entity (Skylark UK). Finance will deliver the journal entry file to your AP contact and provide a signed credit memo PDF within 5 business days.
- Technical fix: INF-3129 hotfix will anchor meter-merge to UTC; rollout scheduled for Thu 2029-07-18 with post-deploy verification.

Please confirm receipt and whether you need a short call to walk through the per-line reconciliation. If you can sign and return the audit template (attached earlier) that will speed the finance handoff.

Thanks for catching this and for the clear CSV — it made validation much faster.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
